Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday. Procurement flagged the security exhibit and audit language in the draft MSA/order form. Two items they asked us to clarify:

1) SOC 2 evidence cadence — they want to understand exactly what evidence Redwood will provide (full report, SOC2 Type II, controls matrix, complementary user-entity controls) and the timeline for delivery each year.
2) Pen test access and scope — they want to confirm whether Atlas Health will be given "audit-style" access (on-site or virtual) and what the notice/window looks like.

Hi Dana — thanks for the note and the clear list. Looping in Legal (Karthik), Security (Laura) and Sales Ops (Ben) to propose concrete language and an operational plan.

High-level proposal from Redwood:
- SOC 2: we will provide an annual SOC 2 Type II report (attestation) plus a controls matrix tailored to the services in scope within 30 days of completed attestation. For targeted evidence requests (e.g., logs, configuration snapshots) we provide a documented evidence cadence: initial onboarding package + quarterly targeted evidence packages (if required by the customer) and an ad-hoc evidence process with a 10-business-day SLA for standard items.
- Pen test / auditor access: we do not permit unlimited walk-in audits. We offer either (a) review of SOC 2 + evidence packages; (b) virtual auditor access to redacted logs and systems for scoped audits with 30 days' notice; or (c) on-prem/remote in-depth audit once per 12-month period by a mutually agreed independent auditor with pre-defined scope and reasonable confidentiality procedures.

Attached are a short operations checklist and the draft order form with a couple of initial redlines. Karthik, Laura — please review the language below and the redlines; recommend any legal/ops constraints or alternate wording.

Attachments: Draft-OrderForm-Redlines.docx, SOC2-Scope-Summary.pdf

- Karthik: legal redlines and suggested working text by EOD Wed 10/7
- Laura: brief ops runbook + evidence owner list by Thu 10/8
- Ben: updated order form with pricing and order form versioning by Thu 10/8

Dana — if that timeline works, we will send a consolidated redline and runbook by Fri 10/9 so procurement can circulate.

Subject: RE: MSA / Order Form — SOC 2 & Pen Test ops checklist and timeline

Jasmine / Dana — I reviewed the draft. Below are proposed redlines and the rationale. I attached a clean redline doc with line-by-line edits. Key points: 

1) Audit rights (MSA §7.4): replace broad "upon reasonable notice" language with: "Customer may conduct a compliance audit limited to the scope of Redwood's SOC 2 report and the specific services purchased; such audit shall be conducted no more than once per 12-month period, by an independent auditor reasonably acceptable to Redwood, and Customer shall provide at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice. Redwood will provide a SOC 2 attestation and associated controls matrix within thirty (30) days of issuance as primary evidence."

Rationale: protects Redwood from frequent intrusive audits while preserving customer assurance via SOC 2 attestation.

2) Pen test access: add explicit scoping language: pen tests by Customer must be vendor-coordinated, limited to an agreed IP range and list of endpoints, and scheduled with at least fifteen (15) business days' notice; Redwood will provide a summary of findings to Customer and share remediation timelines for Redwood-managed vulnerabilities. If Customer uses its own contractor, the contractor must execute Redwood's standard NDA and follow Redwood's testing playbook.

3) Evidence delivery: allow for redaction and aggregation where vendor- or customer-sensitive items exist; specify standard evidence items and timelines (SOC 2 report, controls matrix, configuration snapshot, sample logs) and an ad-hoc request SLA (10 business days for standard items; complex legal/forensic requests may require negotiation).

Please see the attached Redline-MSA.docx for exact wording. If Atlas needs stronger in-place audit rights, we can consider a limited "on-site observation" clause with explicit limitations to avoid operational disruption.

Happy to discuss.
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redline-MSA.docx

Subject: RE: MSA / Order Form — SOC 2 & Pen Test ops checklist and timeline

Team — quick ops notes to make the legal text actionable for procurement: 

- Evidence owner matrix: Security (Laura) will own SOC 2 report handoff; Engineering (Ben will coordinate) will own configuration snapshots and scoped logs. We will prepare a one-page runbook describing how to request evidence and expected delivery timelines (attachments below).
- Pen test coordination: we recommend the Customer pick one of three options in the exhibit: (A) rely on SOC 2 + proof-of-remediation; (B) vendor-coordinated pen test using Customer's vendor with 15 business days notice + vendor NDA; (C) annual independent audit (once per 12 months) with 30 days' notice and mutually agreed scope. Option selection should be captured on the Order Form.
- Operational constraints: no more than two (2) systems per test without separate change windows; we will provide read-only access or redacted logs for forensic requests; live secrets will not be shared.

I will produce the runbook and the evidence-owner contact list by EOD Thu 10/8. Ben, please attach the updated order form (v3) with the chosen exhibit option — we should push to procurement the same day.

Laura Bennett
Director, Information Security, Redwood Inference
